name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
one_liner: A command-line tool that lets an AI assistant browse the web like a person — reading pages, clicking buttons, filling forms — one step at a time.
buyer: A no-code automation agency that builds custom web-scraping or form-filling bots for clients whose target websites have no API.
business_use_cases: An automation agency builds a bot that logs into a client's supplier portals and pulls pricing data every morning, sold as a monitoring service.
A recruiting-ops team automates posting the same job listing across a dozen job boards that have no API, saving hours per week.
A market-research freelancer scrapes competitor pricing and product pages for a retail client's weekly competitor report.

money_ideas.idea: Custom browser-automation bot builds for clients whose sites have no API
Ongoing 'we monitor these websites for you' data-feed subscription

steal_this: Build one scraper this weekend that checks a client's three biggest competitors' prices daily and emails them a summary, then charge a flat monthly fee.
